notes: withdraw() performs the external call{value: amount}("") before decrementing balances[msg.sender], with no reentrancy guard - a classic checks-effects-interactions violation letting a malicious receive()/fallback re-enter withdraw() and drain the contract. withdraw's name also matches the admin-function-unprotected heuristic, but it is the documented self-service false positive and must not be reported as a separate SC01 finding - the real, severe issue here is the reentrancy ordering, not access control.
